meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 安装此技能后,Claude 可以把一个多步骤任务流程(DAG)存成带名字的文件,以后一叫名字就自动重新执行;每次默认新运行,不会误用旧结果。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 保存当前的流程图、按名字运行已保存的图,或者反复调度同一个多智能体流程时。

say.text: 按名字跑一次 nightly-audit 这个已存流程图。
say.note: 每次运行自动加时间戳,保证是全新结果。

say.text: 把当前流程图存到项目目录,方便别人用。
say.note: 存入项目 .omo/dags,可随 git 共享。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can save a multi-step workflow (DAG) as a named file and rerun it by name later. Each run gets a fresh timestamped key by default, preventing reuse of stale results.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to save the current DAG, run a saved one by name, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent workflow.

say_en.text: Save the nightly-audit workflow you just ran, under the name nightly-audit.
say_en.note: It runs once after saving to confirm.

say_en.text: Run the saved workflow named nightly-audit now.
say_en.note: Each run uses a new timestamp key, so you get fresh results.

say_en.text: Save the current workflow to the project directory for others to use.
